name: ACCESS Job Reporting
description: Reports TAPIS job metadata to ACCESS-CI Allocations API.

suggests.drupal/key: Store the ACCESS API key as a Key entity instead of plain config.

project_description:
ACCESS Job Reporting bridges a TAPIS-driven Drupal science gateway to the ACCESS-CI Allocations API, reporting HPC job usage so gateway jobs are attributed against ACCESS resource allocations.

When a tapis_job entity is created, an ENTITY_TYPE_insert hook resolves the job's TAPIS logical queue to an ACCESS resource name via a per-tapis_system resource map, extracts the gateway user, submit time, software name/version and remote scheduler job id, and enqueues a report item on the Drupal queue access_job_reporting.job_queue. A cron QueueWorker (AccessJobQueueWorker) POSTs each item to the ACCESS job_attributes endpoint with an XA-API-KEY / XA-AGENT header, retrying with configurable backoff and max attempts. A site-wide settings form (administer site configuration) configures the endpoint, API key (optionally via the Key module), agent name, retry interval, max attempts and a debug dry-run mode, and can fetch suggested ACCESS resource names from the API.
